target.description: SuttaCentral Mahāsaṅgīti-derived Pāli root text, Roman script, preserved in the pinned Bilara published snapshot. Root edition metadata reports Dhamma Society Fund, Bangkok, 2010; SuttaCentral adapted structure/markup and sometimes punctuation.
required_properties: Only the root/pli/ms source layer is selected; English Sujato translations, comments, variants, parallels and HTML are separate layers.
A supplied root text does not establish a universally original reading or ToS textual acceptance.
Collection/file coverage is checked within this version, not as complete coverage of the Tipiṭaka or all recensions.
